wholePhysicalScope: The native ruins precinct and the three named survey nodes fix the north–south architectural sequence. Room dimensions, marble fragments and individual retaining lines are estimated.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the separate fountain arch and pavilion fragments and the five-panel viewing screen. Street and close levels add inset carving, fluted columns, rounded masonry and scattered broken stone.
limitations: The model covers three visible remains on the Western Mansions axis, anchored at the Great Fountain on the story’s original site. The wider park grounds and other ruins occupy separate places.

The standing fragments, carved shapes and collapsed courses follow the surviving form documented by public-domain photography. Precise stone profiles, restoration joints, heights and fragment positions are estimates.

The original terrain preserves the broad site grade. Low ruin platforms reproduce above-ground shapes. Lost fountains, bronze sculpture, original palace interiors and temporary visitor barriers are outside the modeled scope.
